propositions: The reported claim that link-audit --repair fails due to ModuleNotFoundError on rebar_reconciler import was disproven; the engine_dir path is inserted into sys.path before the import, allowing the probe to succeed.

A discriminating runtime experiment proved check_pass_lock correctly honors lease expiry and returns False when the lease has expired (H1 confirmed), rejecting the hypothesis that stale locks block repair forever (H2 rejected).
The reconciler lock guard operates as designed: it blocks repair operations while a genuine lease is active and permits them once the lease expires, enforcing the correct fail-closed contract.
_reconciler_in_flight function has no test coverage, representing a genuine coverage gap distinct from any functional defect.
